# Memory footprint — module-load deltas (fresh node child, --expose-gc)

*Generated by `bench/measure_memory.mjs`. Delta = process.memoryUsage()
after importing the compiled module (post-GC) minus before. Machine- and
node-version-dependent; regenerate before citing.*

| Fixture | rss Δ (KiB) | heapUsed Δ (KiB) |
|---|--:|--:|
| dashboard_500 (compiled .ps→JS + runtime) | 4356 | 468 |
| app_1000 (compiled .ps→JS + runtime) | 4620 | 557 |

No interpreter ships: the delta is the compiled module + the pyths-runtime helpers it imports.
